requirements.requirement: The system must execute an integration test that invokes evaluate_care_facade and retrieves clinical trial results including status scores.
The system must verify that each clinical trial object in the facade response contains a status_score field.
The system must validate that the status_score value matches the deterministic output from clinical_trials_service for a given input status.
The system must confirm that RECRUITING trials receive a higher status_score than COMPLETED or TERMINATED trials in the integration test dataset.
The system must ensure the facade response structure remains backward compatible aside from the addition of the status_score field.
The system must validate that status_score values are within the normalized range defined in the scoring schema.
The system must confirm that trials with UNKNOWN or missing status still return a status_score field with a valid default value.
The system must fail the integration test if the status_score field is absent from any trial in the response.
The system must fail the integration test if the facade returns a null or non-numeric status_score.
The system must validate that the number of trials returned by the facade matches the number produced by clinical_trials_service for the same input.
The system must simulate an exception where clinical_trials_service returns no trials and verify the facade returns an empty list without error.
The system must simulate an exception where clinical_trials_service returns a trial with an invalid status and verify the facade assigns a default status_score.
The system must ensure the integration test executes through the full stack without mocking the scoring logic.
The system must validate that the API response containing status_score is serializable to JSON without errors.
The system must ensure that any LLM-consuming layer receives the status_score field consistently across all trials in the response.
The system must verify that status_score values are stable across repeated identical integration test runs.
The system must confirm that ordering of trials in the response does not affect correctness of status_score validation.
The system must validate that the facade does not overwrite or mutate unrelated trial fields when adding status_score.
